# PeriodNav

The one way to move through time in SongNodes: previous/next, jump to now, the period's name and a Day/Week/Month scale, with [ and ] on the keyboard.

`SongNodes.PeriodNav` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.PeriodNav scale="day" start={…} onChange={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.PeriodNav" scale="day" start="{{…}}" on-change="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (PeriodNavProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scale` * | `"day" \| "week" \| "month"` | Current scale. |
| `start` * | `Date` | Start of the shown period (weeks start Monday, Australia/Melbourne). |
| `onChange` * | `(next: { scale: "day" \| "week" \| "month"; start: Date }) => void` | Called when the period or scale changes. |
| `scales` | `("day" \| "week" \| "month")[]` | Hide the Day/Week/Month control for views with a single scale. |
| `max` | `Date` | Latest period that has data; Next is disabled beyond it. |
| `keyboard` | `boolean` | Bind [ and ] for this instance (one per page). |
